summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds `from enum import Enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) class with the eleven members from the spec; botocore/args.py imports the enum, makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags), and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) covering every behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 61 passed; test_client.py, test_regions.py, test_endpoint.py 384 passed. Choices: SDK_ENDPOINT is always a key and is None when absent; the helper calls the bridge's underscore-prefixed lookups directly; a duplicate legacy-URL test was kept. Not run: black/flake8 line-length check. Nothing committed.
